verdict.rationale: RunAnywhere is an on-device and cloud model inference SDK, so serving embedding models for retrieval is a fair axis to ask about. The docs cover LLM generation, chat, STT, TTS, VAD, diarization, VLM, and image generation, but none of them mention embedding models, an embeddings API, or retrieval/search use cases. The OpenAI-compatible endpoint is not documented as exposing embeddings.
